workflow: A test launches a subprocess and waits for it to signal readiness within a fixed short timeout.
Execution instrumentation and parallel system load slow startup and readiness signaling beyond that deadline.
The wait expires before the subprocess becomes ready, producing a timeout or readiness error.
The test reports failure even though the subprocess may complete correctly given a longer environment-adjusted timeout.
decision_reason: The failure workflow is materially identical: instrumentation and concurrent load delay otherwise valid work beyond a fixed timeout, causing a test expectation failure rather than an underlying operation failure.
